rule: United_States replication must pass AND >=2 other countries pass; a country passes when its predicted rest day is the lowest weekday with Bonferroni-adjusted null-test p < 0.05/m in >= 2 streams

replication_check.note: A fail here means investigate data, method and comparability with Earl et al. 2015; it is not by itself proof of a bug.

caveats: A robust rest-day dip is consistent with human scheduling of burning; it does not by itself establish ignition cause. Absence of a dip does not establish weather-driven fire.
Streams observe overlapping fires: agreement is corroboration, not independent replication.
Observation coverage (cloud, overpass gaps) by weekday is not measured.
label: REAL FIRMS DATA
